film: SI MATH AI — THE AI COURT
document: VO line manifest — machine-readable source for the 19-line record
rule: Picture is cut to the read, never the reverse. All 19 lines are recorded before any dialogue shot is animated.

casting.route: Human VO — one actor, both roles, alternating lines, single session, same room, same mic. The kit's preferred Stage 0 route and the fullest form of its ranked option 1 ('one actor with real range').
casting.kit_reference: docs/film/01_Production_Script.md — 'VOICE CASTING', including the ⚠️ REVISIT block

delivery_spec.note: One file per line — each becomes the audio_references input to that line's seedance_2_0 shot. A single continuous session file cannot be used directly; it must be split per line first.

tts_fallback.status: NOT IN USE — superseded by the human VO decision
tts_fallback.purpose: Retained only for emergency pickups if a line is unusable and the actor is unavailable.

JZ.brief: 55–70, deep chest resonance, no vocal fry. Morgan Freeman's tempo × a tenured professor's precision.
JZ.booth_direction: You already know how this ends. You're speaking so the room hears it.

LZ.brief: 25–32, bright, forward placement, crisp consonants, momentum.
LZ.booth_direction: You're not asking questions. You're setting a trap, and you're enjoying it.
LZ.never: Smug. Sarcastic. Mocking the other side.

notes: Per-line target_sec = words / wpm × 60, using the act wpm the kit specifies. These are the kit's own budget decomposed per line, not new numbers.

OWNER AMENDMENT 2026-07-31: L2 moved from the kit's Act I 130 wpm to Lawyer Zero's own 165 wpm (3.23s → 2.55s). Act I speech is now 5.32s rather than 6.0s and total speech 47.41s rather than 48.1s, so the silence budget grows by 0.68s.
OVERRUN RULE (kit): if the read comes back long, take it out of the beats in Act II — never out of Act III. The verdict's pauses are the film.
OPEN: Shot 4 allots L2 one second against a 2.55s line, and Act II has no slack to absorb the overhang. Either Shot 4 extends and Act II compresses, or L2 overlaps the Shot 4 → Shot 5 cut. See 06 §4.
L10 'The defence rests.' — music cuts to absolute silence on the final word. Protect in the mix.
L15/L16 must share an identical cadence; L17 lands a half-step softer.

Expression names refer to the six labelled panels on the character expression sheets (ac71e214 Judge, a36e371d Lawyer). Those sheets are PENDING — naming a panel on paper is safe, but no shot generates against them until they pass Gate 2 (Law 11).

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: This court is now in session.
lines.delivery: Stated, not announced. He is confirming what the room already knows.
lines.eye_direction: Tracks left across the room before the line, then settles forward. One blink after the final word, never during.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Then let me ask a few questions.
lines.delivery: Light. Almost pleasant. The trap is already built.
lines.camera: Cam 12/A axis · 35mm · eye level · low tracking arc
lines.eye_direction: To the bench first, then across to the grey table on the last word.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Who knows exactly where the student went wrong?
lines.delivery: The first strike. Direct, to the grey table. Stress 'where'.
lines.camera: Cam 12/A · 50mm · eye level · medium · slow push
lines.eye_direction: To the grey table, held. Never at the hologram — he watches the jury.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Who knows why — instead of only saying 'wrong'?
lines.delivery: Faster. The italicised word carries the sentence. Stress 'why'.
lines.eye_direction: To the grey table. Delivers 'wrong' in audible quotes.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: A concept gap. A calculation slip. Carelessness. Or time?
lines.delivery: Four beats, metronome-even. He counts them on his claws.
lines.eye_direction: Down to his claws on each count, up to the grey table on 'Or time?'

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Who sees the same mistake — for weeks?
lines.delivery: The dash is a real pause. 'Weeks' lands like evidence.
lines.eye_direction: To the grey table, then up as the timeline multiplies past frame edges.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Who turns one wrong answer into a plan?
lines.delivery: Warmer. This is where prosecution becomes advocacy.
lines.eye_direction: To the grey table, softened — no longer interrogating them.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Who knows what to study next?
lines.camera: Cam 12/A · 50mm · MCU · rise with the card
lines.eye_direction: Up and forward, rising with the card. Past the grey table now.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.text: Who walks the whole road — from the first question to the target score?
lines.delivery: The longest line he has. Let it breathe mid-dash.
lines.eye_direction: Along the path toward the bench, then thrown to camera.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: Quiet. Final. He is done, and he knows he has won.
lines.eye_direction: To the bench. Back turned to the grey table.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: To the grey table. Generous, and true. No irony — the ruling is fair, which is what makes it land.
lines.eye_direction: Straight down the lens, to the grey table.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.text: But this one was built for students.
lines.delivery: The verdict. Slow. Each word placed like a stone.
lines.eye_direction: Down the lens. Hold one full second on the eyes before the line.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Over the rising constellation. Pride held under the robe.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: The thesis. Slowest line in the film.
lines.eye_direction: To camera, seen through the orbiting holograms.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.eye_direction: Down the lens; drops to the floor as the law burns into the marble.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Second law. Same cadence exactly as L15.
lines.eye_direction: Down the lens; drops to the floor as the law burns into the marble.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Third law. A half-step softer — it resolves, not escalates.
lines.eye_direction: Down the lens; drops to the floor as the law burns into the marble.

lines.speaker: JZ
lines.delivery: Spoken while descending the steps. Not to anyone. To everyone.
lines.camera: Descent crane · 35mm · descending with him · full, low
lines.eye_direction: Middle distance, down the steps. Not to the Lawyer, not to camera.

lines.speaker: LZ
lines.delivery: The only soft line he has. Close, warm, almost private. The student finishing the teacher's sentence.
lines.camera: Merge two-shot · 50mm · eye level · 90° dolly to profile
lines.eye_direction: To Judge Zero, held. Pure profile two-shot.
